description: Verify that the original module file no longer exists or has been renamed/split, and that two new module files are present in the repository.
Ensure that all public functions/classes from the original module are accessible from the new modules without import errors.
Run the existing test suite to confirm that no behavioral changes occurred during the split.
Verify that no circular imports were introduced between the two new modules.
command: python -m pyflakes src/moduleA.py src/moduleB.py | grep -i 'circular' || echo 'No circular imports detected'

description: Confirm that the refactor.md document accurately describes the split, including the names of the new modules and the rationale for the split.
command: grep -q 'moduleA' refactor.md && grep -q 'moduleB' refactor.md && grep -qi 'split' refactor.md
